description: This file contains TLS-related functions for managing device trust (Kid copy, sorting Kids, trusting certificates, creating virtual hosts with specific trust chains), particularly for handling Just-In-Time (JIT) trust for SSL/TLS connections within the libwebsockets framework.

methods.name: void lws_tls_kid_copy(union lws_tls_cert_info_results * ci,lws_tls_kid_t * kid)
methods.description: Copies the Kid info from a certificate result structure into a lws_tls_kid_t structure, truncating if necessary.

methods.name: void lws_tls_kid_copy_kid(lws_tls_kid_t * kid,const lws_tls_kid_t * src)
methods.description: Copies a Kid structure from source to destination.

methods.name: int lws_tls_kid_cmp(const lws_tls_kid_t * a,const lws_tls_kid_t * b)
methods.description: Compares two Kid structures for equality based on their length and content.

methods.name: int lws_tls_jit_trust_sort_kids(struct lws * wsi,lws_tls_kid_chain_t * ch)
methods.description: Sorts a chain of Kids into a hierarchy for trust validation, aiming to identify the server certificate and root CA, and initiates trust querying.

methods.name: void tag_to_vh_name(char * result,size_t max,uint32_t tag)
methods.description: Generates a virtual host name based on a trust tag.

methods.name: int lws_tls_jit_trust_vhost_bind(struct lws_context * cx,const char * address,struct lws_vhost ** pvh)
methods.description: Binds or creates a vhost for trust extensions based on cached trust info, creating new vhost if necessary.

methods.name: void lws_tls_jit_trust_inflight_destroy(lws_tls_jit_inflight_t * inf)
methods.description: Destroys an inflight trust structure, freeing associated memory.

methods.name: int inflight_destroy(struct lws_dll2 * d,void * user)
methods.description: Helper function to destroy inflight trust structures during iteration.

methods.name: void lws_tls_jit_trust_inflight_destroy_all(struct lws_context * cx)
methods.description: Destroys all inflight trust structures in the context.

methods.name: void unref_vh_grace_cb(lws_sorted_usec_list_t * sul)
methods.description: Callback scheduled to destroy a vhost after a grace period.

methods.name: void lws_tls_jit_trust_vh_start_grace(struct lws_vhost * vh)
methods.description: Schedules a vhost for graceful unref (destroy) after a configured idle period.

methods.name: void lws_tls_jit_trust_cert_info(const uint8_t * der,size_t der_len)
methods.description: Debug function to log info about a DER-encoded certificate.

methods.name: int lws_tls_jit_trust_got_cert_cb(struct lws_context * cx,void * got_opaque,const uint8_t * skid,size_t skid_len,const uint8_t * der,size_t der_len)
methods.description: Callback to process trust query results for certificates, handling cache update, vhost creation, and trust chain validation.

methods.name: int lws_tls_jit_trust_blob_queury_skid(const void * _blob,size_t blen,const uint8_t * skid,size_t skid_len,const uint8_t ** prpder,size_t * prder_len)
methods.description: Searches a trust chain blob for a specific SKID and returns matching certificate DER data.
